_comment: Three-factor comparison on Sudoku-Extreme 1k (data/sudoku_lt_1k.npz), small model. The bands EMA model of configs/bands_bps16.json in zxcyxv/something (4 bands, periods 2/6/20/64, eta learned from 0.125 and capped, bands and eta without weight decay, 16 blocks per segment all backpropagated, 16 segments = 256 blocks per puzzle) at width 512 (8 heads of 64) instead of 832. The arms of scripts/tf_runs.sh add only their flags: bands (none), tf_zero (three_factor), tf_w0 (three_factor, w0_learned), w0 (w0_learned). A milestone every 5k steps runs 128 segments (8x the training depth) on 512 held-out puzzles.
